user_request: Form a database of experimentally supported disinfection byproducts.
refined_definition: A disinfection byproduct is a specific chemical compound formed during a water disinfection or oxidation process when disinfectants or oxidants react with precursors in real or simulated water matrices, with evidence attributing formation to that treatment process.

stages.name: Intent refinement
stages.note: User request converted into mandatory and exclusionary predicates.

stages.name: Dynamic literature construction
stages.note: Broad topic search plus candidate-triggered follow-up retrieval.

stages.name: Candidate funnel
stages.note: NER, grounding, ranking and LLM triage reduce noisy mentions.

stages.name: Predicate-state verification
stages.note: Researcher-Critique loop checks each candidate against evidence.
